items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: this job I got in Detroit with McKinney's Cotton Pickers... he hired me

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Well, anyway, I -- when the -- this -- this job I got in Detroit with McKinney's Cotton Pickers, I wasn't working, and McKinney came to New York. Actually he came because he wanted to hire Benny Carter. So Benny Carter was involved with his own band and whatever, and he told McKinney, you know, about me. So I went out there and he hired me and -- for a lot of money in those days, more money than I'd ever made up till that time. Something like $160.00 a week. I had never made no money like that, you…
Yeah, I know which one you mean.
